Janusweb supports peertube instances by auto-generating a 3D room around it.
This can be triggered in various ways:

<video width="100%" style="max-width:900px" controls>
  <source src="_media/peertube.mp4" type="video/mp4"/>
  Your browser does not support the video tag.
</video>

## Via the url-bar

1. enter an peertube instance URL
2. enter an peertube instance channel URL
3. enter an peertube instance video URL

> example: type `makertube.net` in the urlbar

## Programmatically

You can add portals/textures to your world/room in the following ways:

```xml
<!-- this will create a clickable portal to the rss -->
<link url="https://makertube.net"/>
```
